verses.text: A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: “There is no fear of God before his eyes.”
lines: A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked:
“There is no fear of God before his eyes.”

verses.text: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.
lines: For he flatters himself in his own eyes,
too much to detect and hate his sin.

verses.text: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.
lines: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit.
He has ceased to be wise and to do good.

verses.text: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.
lines: He plots iniquity on his bed.
He sets himself in a way that is not good.
He doesn’t abhor evil.

verses.text: Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
lines: Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens.
Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

verses.text: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. Yahweh, you preserve man and animal.
lines: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God.
Your judgments are like a great deep.
Yahweh, you preserve man and animal.

verses.text: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
lines: How precious is your loving kindness, God!
The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.

verses.text: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.
lines: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house.
You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.

verses.text: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.
lines: For with you is the spring of life.
In your light we will see light.

verses.text: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.
lines: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you,
your righteousness to the upright in heart.

verses.text: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.
lines: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me.
Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.

verses.text: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.
lines: There the workers of iniquity are fallen.
They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.
